categories.evidence: Modifies CWallet::CreateNew in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and adds wallet tests for creation error handling.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled exception crash in bitcoin-qt and prevents stale files on failed creation. As noted in the description, when external signer setup fails, an uncaught runtime_error on a worker thread triggers std::terminate, and leaves an empty database directory behind that blocks subsequent attempts.
